challenge.title: Draw your best screen in 3 lines
challenge.rules: Three lines of Yui Lines or fewer. Comments and blank lines are free. It has to parse with no errors and draw at least one thing.

entries.title: Morning check-in
entries.yl:
say "Morning. How did you sleep?"
slide "Sleep" 1-5 Rough|Great
pick "Today I want to" Move|Focus|Rest|"See people"

entries.title: A whole workout in one line
Weekly weigh-in
entries.yl:
stat 178.9lb Weight delta=-2.3 spark=181.2|180.6|179.8|178.9 good=down sub="this week"
chart line "Last 4 weeks" x=W1|W2|W3|W4 y=181.2|180.6|179.8|178.9
ask "Keep the same plan?"

entries.title: How far does it fly?
entries.yl:
say "Drag the sliders. The answer moves with you."
calc "How far does it fly?" f="R = v^2*sin(2*a)/g" v=5-40@20m/s a=0-90@30deg g=9.81m/s^2 plot=a unit=m

entries.title: Settle dinner
entries.yl:
say "Three votes in. Tacos lead."
choose "Your vote?" Tacos|Ramen|Pizza +other
table Votes Dish|Votes "Tacos|2" "Ramen|1" "Pizza|0"
